name: annual-diary-insight
title_zh: 把十年日记摊成一张可下钻的年轮看板
tagline_zh: 年度洞察要精读全年日记后人写；大事记只问一句「哪天之后你回不去了」，一年五到八条，还专收「未遂里程碑」。
tagline_en: The yearly piece has to be written by hand after reading every entry. The milestone list asks one question — which day did you stop being able to go back — five to eight a year, including the ones that almost happened.
desc_en: annual-diary-insight 是一个把多年日记变成「年度洞察」与「全景看板」的 skill。功能 A：逐篇精读当年日记，人写十段式深度复盘（数字快照、主题、身份、金句、给明年），不靠统计填模板。功能 B：读取各年洞察，自动生成单页离线 HTML 看板，含主题、情绪、节律、里程碑时间线等七模块。纯 Python 标准库、无外部依赖、图表库内联，换库只需填一份 vault-profile
why_zh: 它故意不给「自动生成正文」的脚本：统计只说明反复提到什么，跳过精读的必然是换年份也成立的废话。
why_en: It deliberately ships no script that writes the yearly piece for you: word frequencies only show what you kept mentioning, and skipping the close read produces prose that would be true of any year.
limit_zh: 得先有几年成体量的日记，没日记它无事可做。看板的时间线直接读洞察里人工标的条目，洞察没写就是空的，顺序只能先 A 再 B。单页 HTML 有 1.1 MB，正文说这是把 ECharts 内联进去换离线可用的刻意取舍。
limit_en: You need several years of substantial diary entries; without them there is nothing to run. The dashboard timeline reads the milestones you marked by hand in the yearly pieces, so it stays empty until those exist, and the order is fixed. The single-page HTML weighs 1.1 MB because ECharts is inlined to keep it usable offline — a trade the file states outright.
title_en: Turn years of diary entries into one drillable annual ring.
